name: slam-dunk-backend-hono
description: Standalone Hono.js Backend for ANIME DAZE / Slam Dunk Platform on Vercel

scripts.build: prisma generate && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --external:@prisma/client --external:@prisma/adapter-pg --external:pg --format=cjs --footer:js="const { handle } = require('@hono/node-server/vercel'); module.exports = handle(app); module.exports.default = module.exports;" --outfile=api/index.js
